text: The music and film industry has changed enormously over the past twenty years. In the past, people had to go to the cinema or buy an album to enjoy their favourite entertainment. Nowadays, however, streaming has made it possible to watch a blockbuster or listen to a new soundtrack instantly, from anywhere in the world. Before a film is released, a director usually works closely with actors, who rehearse their scenes many times to make the performance as realistic as possible. A composer may also compose original music, sometimes writing an instrumental theme that becomes as famous as the film itself. Meanwhile, songwriters carefully choose lyrics that match the mood of each scene. Once a film reaches cinemas, its success is often measured by box office earnings and by the reviews it receives from critics. Some films, especially adaptations of popular novels, attract a huge audience because people already know the plot. Although not every film is a box office hit, the best ones manage to entertain audiences of every genre, from comedy to drama, and even turn talented but unknown actors into celebrities.
